minutes.headline: ZBA granted a special permit to raze and rebuild a Sunset Lane home, then chose a traffic peer reviewer for Pond View Commons.
minutes.summary: The board heard the 398 Sunset Lane special permit application and granted it by roll call. It then continued the Pond View Commons 40B comprehensive permit hearing, picked a traffic peer reviewer, and voted not to engage any reviewer until fees are in the account. Engineering peer review, sewer and water review, and fees were put off to the next hearing.

public_comment.topic: The 40B applicant said he has a conflict with one of the two traffic peer review firms, MDM, and had no problem with the cost of the other.
For the Sewer Commission, recommended Wright-Pierce as sewer peer reviewer and offered to supply a detailed price structure and capacity information.
Spoke by Zoom in favor of an environmental peer reviewer on stormwater and water quality, citing his water sampling of the brook above Hickory Hills Lake.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit for 398 Sunset Lane as requested.
votes.outcome: passed; roll call of ayes heard, the chair announced the permit granted

votes.motion: Offer the traffic peer review contract to Vanessa Associates.
votes.outcome: passed; ayes heard on roll call, full count not audible

votes.motion: Do not engage any peer reviewer until sufficient fees are deposited to cover the cost.
votes.outcome: passed; ayes heard, chair said the motion passed

votes.motion: Continue the 40B comprehensive permit hearing to November 9th at 7.

budget_items.topic: Traffic peer review quotes, Vanessa Associates and MDM
budget_items.what_was_said: Counsel compared the two lump-sum quotes. Vanessa's includes two public meetings, while MDM's excludes meetings and charges per meeting.

budget_items.topic: Sewer peer review by Wright-Pierce, recommended by the Sewer Commission
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the Sewer Commission has an estimate for sewer-only review.

budget_items.topic: Applicant's cost estimates for water and sewer compared with the town's
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the gap between the applicant's costs and the town's could be large and raised red flags.

budget_items.topic: Applicant's request for a waiver or reduction of peer review fees
budget_items.what_was_said: The board will take up the fee waiver at the next hearing. Counsel said reviewers should not be engaged until the money is deposited in the account, and the applicant would fund the reviews while reserving the right to argue about fees.

decisions.decision: Engineering peer review was put off to the next hearing because no civil engineering quotes were received. Staff will keep seeking quotes.
Next hearing is November 9th. It will cover civil engineering quotes, fees, and the start of the sewer and water discussion.
Counsel advised giving the applicant notice that sewer, water and environmental peer review will be discussed later. Stormwater review is expected to fall within the civil engineering review.
A board member asked Mr. Strassmeyer to put his environmental concerns in writing to the board, and he agreed.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit to raze and rebuild a home at 398 Sunset Lane, by roll call.
The board offered the Pond View Commons 40B traffic peer review contract to Vanessa Associates, after the applicant said he had a conflict with the other firm.
The board voted not to engage any peer reviewer until enough fees are deposited to cover the cost.
Engineering peer review was put off because no civil engineering quotes were received; sewer, water and environmental review were deferred as well.
The 40B comprehensive permit hearing was continued to November 9th at 7.

why_it_matters: Peer reviewers are the town's independent check on a large 40B housing proposal's traffic, stormwater, sewer and water effects, and the funding vote means that review starts only once fees are deposited.
Review of sewer, water and stormwater was not decided at this meeting, so the town's technical scrutiny of Pond View Commons is still incomplete.
watch_next: November 9th at 7: the continued Pond View Commons hearing, covering civil engineering quotes, fees and the start of the sewer and water discussion.
The applicant's request to waive or reduce peer review fees, which the board said it will take up at the next hearing.
